name: Derive SM90 shared-memory alignment from swizzle
summary: Derive shared-memory alignment requirements from the selected Hopper swizzle and use the maximum operand requirement for pipeline storage.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Compute alignment independently for A and B layout atoms and propagate their maximum into stage-count and storage construction.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.
